regime_context: The Hang Seng thematic universe shows a narrowing rotation with only 6 of 17 themes passing the absolute trend gate (eligible). Tech Hardware & Semis is the headline theme but has thin breadth (0.33), while the top-ranked Diversified Miners is ineligible. No single narrative dominates. The gate has historically reduced drawdowns in this market, so eligible themes may offer better risk control.
emerging_watch: Watch for a potential leadership handoff from Diversified Miners to Tech Hardware & Semis if its internal breadth rises above 0.5 AND its momentum score overtakes Miners' score — which would suggest a confirmed rotation into the headline theme.
